## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, examples, build, tests)

- [ ] Added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under the next version
- [ ] New endpoints and events follow the conventions in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] No em dashes in new text (repo style)
